data.headline: Revoke the idle marketing-trial intent to recover $0.80, restrict the unrestricted ops agent to named merchants, and raise the cloud-infra cap—it is throttling at 98% per-transaction utilization.

findings.title: Idle capital on revoked intent
findings.detail: Intent 0xe88b02abd36a10617386cd71105ff39276ccdf16 (Marketing tools trial) was revoked after trial ended but still holds $0.80 of unspent funded balance. This capital is locked and recoverable.

findings.title: Unrestricted merchant allowlist on active, high-cap intent
findings.detail: Intent 0x568222982112b7bd55bd90524e1434472f422f5b (General ops agent) is Active with a $10 total cap and $2 per-tx cap but has zero merchants on its allowlist (unrestrictedMerchants: true). This creates broad spend exposure without containment.

findings.title: Cloud-infra intent undersized for recurring weekly spend
findings.detail: Intent 0x4e0866d3c7ac1acbd4058cc9a0877193e640bcf4 (Cloud infra autopay) has a $2 total cap and $0.50 per-tx cap but both of its two payments hit 98% of the per-tx cap ($0.49 each). Payments this close to limit suggest the agent is being throttled and the cap may need adjustment to reflect actual cost.

actions.rationale: Intent is already revoked and trial has ended. Withdraw the $0.80 unspent funded balance to free capital and clean up idle authorizations.

Define an explicit merchant allowlist for the general ops agent. Currently unrestricted, it can spend up to $10 total and $2 per transaction to any address. Add named merchants only and reject unknown payees.

Both cloud-infra payments consumed 98% of the $0.50 per-tx cap ($0.49 each). At weekly frequency, raise per-tx cap to $0.50–$0.60 and review total cap to match actual spend rate, preventing throttling and payment failures.

dataGaps: No intra-week or historical spend pattern data to confirm if cloud-infra payments will continue weekly or escalate.
No merchant names or categories for the three transacting addresses (0x1111…, 0x2222…, 0x3333…); verify they match their stated purposes (cloud provider, research vendor, marketing tool).
No information on why the general ops intent (0x5682…) has never been used despite 30 days of availability; unclear if it is genuinely needed or should be revoked instead.

intents.purpose: Cloud infra autopay - GPU + storage, weekly
